outputs.explanation: Panel A is a schematic-style diagram illustrating percentage breakdown of exposure time vs illumination overhead, not a data plot averaging replicate measurements.
Panel B is a micrograph, not a plot.
Panel C is a micrograph, not a plot.
Panel D is a line plot (photobleaching decay curves with mean±s.e.m.); line plots are exempt from requiring overlaid individual points.
Panel E is a series of micrographs, not a plot.
Panel F is a scatter plot showing individual data points color-coded by cell (n=5) overlaid with the fitted mean±s.e.m. curve.
Panel G is a scatter plot showing individual data points color-coded by cell (n=5) overlaid with the fitted mean±s.e.m. curve.
Panel H is a scatter plot showing individual data points color-coded by cell (n=5) overlaid with the fitted mean±s.e.m. curve.
Panel I is a micrograph, not a plot.
Panel J is a line plot (normalized intensity over frame number with shaded mean±s.e.m.); line plots are exempt from requiring overlaid individual points.
